Full Florence description

The image shows a modern kitchen with white cabinets and a blue tiled floor. The kitchen has a white countertop with a sink and a coffee maker on it. There is a white oven and a gas stove on the left side of the countertop. On the right side, there is a window with a view of the outside. In the center of the kitchen, there are two black bar stools and a table fan. The floor is made of blue tiles with a speckled pattern. The walls are painted white and there are a few items hanging on the wall.

The image shows an empty office space with a blue tiled floor. The room has white walls and a large window on the left side, allowing natural light to enter. On the right side of the room, there are several desks and chairs arranged in a semi-circle, with a computer monitor, keyboard, and other office supplies on the desks. There are also several potted plants scattered throughout the room. The floor is made of light-colored tiles, and there is a whiteboard on the wall in the background. The ceiling is covered with recessed lighting, and the overall atmosphere of the space is clean and modern.

Full Florence description
The image shows an empty hallway with a black tiled floor. The hallway has two doors on the left side and a whiteboard on the right side. The walls are painted in a light beige color and there are red dots scattered across the floor. In the center of the hallway, there is a large glass door that leads to another room with a window and a radiator. Above the door, there are recessed lighting fixtures. The overall atmosphere of the space is clean and modern.

The image shows the entrance of a building with a large glass door. The door is made of glass and has a handle on the right side. The walls are painted in a light beige color and there is an air conditioning unit on the wall above the door and a sign above it that reads "Exit". The entrance appears to be empty and is well-lit.
